title: mTOR kinase leads to PTEN-loss-induced cellular senescence by phosphorylating p53

grounded.evidence_quote: In contrast to IR-exposed positive control (PC) group (Fig. 1c, d, g), P-ATM and γH2AX were not observed in active AKT-induced senescence (Fig. 1g).
grounded.location: PTEN depletion induces cellular senescence via the p53-p21 signaling pathway without triggering a DNA damage response
